pages.title: Bring Xianqiao to Block Networks
pages.text: A Spirit Core and Nether Star form the manager. It creates no second inventory; it exposes the owner's existing Xianqiao to world automation safely.

pages.title: Claiming and Placement
pages.text: Only stage-six-or-higher players may claim it, and it works only inside its owner's personal realm. The first eligible interaction claims it; later visitors cannot silently rebind it. Ownership uses the persistent ImmortalStorage identity, not a launcher's current session UUID.

pages.title: Capabilities by Stage
pages.text: Stage six exposes items, stage seven adds fluids, and stage eight adds FE plus registered external resources. Adjacent pipes use standard NeoForge capabilities; AE2 and RS storage buses can also read the same long-valued ledger through native storage APIs. The manager is passive—it does not run a machine-style six-face push.

pages.title: Builders and Networks
pages.text: Create's Schematicannon can treat it as a block-item inventory; Building Gadgets can source copy-paste materials from it. Simulation estimates without consuming, while real construction commits the transfer. A disk and manager bus on one network deduplicate by owner instead of mounting the same inventory twice.

pages.title: Safe When Disconnected
pages.text: If the owner is offline, the stage is insufficient or Xianqiao cannot be resolved, capabilities close instead of pointing at a nearby player. They reconnect when conditions recover. The block never holds a shadow copy, so two ledgers cannot diverge.
